name: application-card
title: ApplicationCard
purpose: Compose a repeatable application surface anatomy while delegating material, geometry, borders, density, and elevation to Card and the active Balsa theme.
useFor: Application sections with optional actions or metadata
avoidFor: Clickable containers that compete with inner controls
accessibility: The composition remains a visual container and does not invent landmark semantics.
headingLevel keeps the generated title in the surrounding document hierarchy.
The header, action, body, and footer slots preserve consumer-owned semantic content.
commonMistakes: Pinning shadow or radius to make one example look correct instead of inheriting the active theme.
Nesting another Card only to create body spacing.
Using a heading level that breaks the surrounding hierarchy.
Using derived feedback colors instead of neutral, primary, secondary, or accent source-palette roles.
